negative_findings.finding_type: actor does not exist as named
negative_findings.description: The coverage cell names 'Postenska/Пошта' as a commercial bank. No licensed 'Поштенска банка' was found in the current MK bank universe. What exists instead is Пошта на Северна Македонија (Post of North Macedonia) acting as a distribution channel — Halkbank services are reported as available through 327 active post-office units.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched mk and en for Поштенска банка / Post bank North Macedonia; only the postal operator and the Halkbank-post distribution arrangement surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a phantom actor from being carried into the source register, and reframes the postal network correctly as an agent/access-point channel (relevant to cash-usage and payment-access-point analysis) rather than a bank issuing cards.

negative_findings.finding_type: metric not disclosed in accessible form
negative_findings.description: No MK bank was found publishing an absolute, machine-readable count of cards issued, ATMs owned or POS terminals deployed on an indexable web page. Where the metric exists it is prose inside an annual-report PDF, and often only as a YoY percentage (Стопанска банка reports '+12% card transactions', '+20% POS/e-commerce', '+9% merchant points' with no base numbers).
negative_findings.result_summary: Six bank-specific searches in mk plus targeted en searches returned narrative/percentage disclosure only; no per-bank fleet-count table found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A4 card/ATM/POS series cannot be built bottom-up from bank disclosures alone at absolute-value precision; bank sources give growth rates and qualitative direction, and must be anchored to a regulator/scheme aggregate for levels.

negative_findings.description: No MK bank was observed publishing a document explicitly branded 'Pillar 3' in the EU sense. The local equivalent appears to be the NBRM-mandated 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' public disclosure (confirmed for ТТК Банка as at 31.12.2024). Genuine Pillar-3 documents exist only at parent-group level (ProCredit Holding under CRR 575/2013).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'pillar 3' + MK bank names returned only group-level holding documents; the local template was found under its Macedonian title instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Anyone searching for 'Pillar 3 MK bank' will get near-zero recall; the correct local search key is 'Извештај и податоци за Банката', which should be used as the cross-bank retrieval string.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice were obtained from search-engine result listings. No page was independently fetched and confirmed reachable during this run, and no liveness or HTTP-status claim is made for any of them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery-only pass; deterministic verification deferred to the downstream pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confidence scores here reflect that the URL was returned by search for the stated entity, not that it resolves today; some deep PDF paths (Cyrillic-encoded, CMS-generated) are the most likely to have moved.

negative_findings.description: Several search keys are noisy: 'Halkbank' collides with Halkbank Turkey, Halkbank a.d. Serbia and Halkbank Turkmenistan; 'Sparkasse' collides with the entire Austrian/German Sparkassen sector; 'Komercijalna banka' collides with NLB Komercijalna banka Beograd; 'НЛБ' returns Slovenian group material. 'Развојна банка' can also refer to development banks generally.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed directly in results — e.g. Halkbank queries returned Turkmenistan and Serbian entities; NLB queries returned Serbian Komercijalna banka pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection must pin queries with 'АД Скопје' / 'AD Skopje' / site: filters, otherwise the corpus silently fills with cross-border homonyms and the MK figures get contaminated.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated investor-relations page with quarterly presentations was found for any MK bank other than Комерцијална банка (which publishes dated KB-PREZENTACIJA PDFs). Other banks appear to disclose only annually, via AGM packs or exchange filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Per-bank searches for 'инвеститори' / 'investor presentation' returned nothing comparable outside kb.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Intra-year monitoring of the MK bank sector will be driven almost entirely by Комерцијална банка's presentations plus NLB Group's quarterly reports; everyone else is an annual-cadence source.

coverage_gaps.description: Капитал банка АД Скопје was named in a search but no reports page or filing repository was confirmed for it in this run; likewise no source was established for any remaining small/savings institutions ('штедилници') outside the main bank list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full licensed-institution list from the NBRM bank directory index and run one targeted mk-language 'финансиски извештаи' search per institution not yet covered here.

coverage_gaps.description: Absolute card/ATM/POS fleet counts per bank remain unsourced; bank disclosures give growth percentages and narrative only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with the regulator/scheme cell (NBRM payment-system statistics, KIBS/CaSys processing data) for levels, and use bank reports for attribution, mix and direction. Additionally scrape bank ATM locator endpoints as an independent fleet census.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language versions of MK bank annual reports were confirmed only for Sparkasse (historic), ProCredit and NLB Group. For Комерцијална, Стопанска, УНИ, ТТК, ЦКБ and Халк the operative documents are Macedonian Cyrillic PDFs, some of which appear to be scans.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for Cyrillic OCR plus a mk→en glossary in the extraction pipeline; do not assume an English mirror exists.

coverage_gaps.description: SEI-Net and SRIS both serve documents from opaque ID-keyed endpoints (FileServer.aspx?file=<id>, Document_SR<id>-<year>-<seq>.pdf); no listing API or per-issuer index URL was established, so systematic harvesting is not yet specified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a hands-on session against seinet.com.mk and sris.sec.gov.mk with a headless browser to capture the issuer-search request/response shape, then build an issuer-scoped crawler rather than guessing IDs.

coverage_gaps.description: Only recent report years (roughly 2019-2025) were sighted on live bank pages; older annual reports (e.g. Комерцијална 2016, Sparkasse 2013) surfaced only incidentally, suggesting banks prune their reports pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the historical back-series from the MSE/SEI-Net/SRIS repositories and web-archive snapshots rather than from bank websites, and mirror everything on first collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group disclosure was established for NLB Group and ProCredit Holding only. Halkbank Turkey (parent of Халкбанк АД Скопје), Steiermärkische Bank und Sparkassen AG (parent of Шпаркасе), OTP/NBG lineage for Стопанска банка and the Bulgarian CCB parent of ЦКБ were not searched at group level.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one dedicated parent-group search per foreign owner, targeting subsidiary/segment tables and country-by-country reporting, since parent reports are often more standardised than the MK filings.

brief: North Macedonia's commercial banks disclose through three overlapping layers: their own websites (annual reports, AGM document packs, ATM locators and card/tariff pages), the exchange-and-regulator filing stack (Македонска берза issuer pages and the Announcement166 repository, SEI-Net, and the Securities Commission's SRIS portal), and foreign parent groups (NLB Group and ProCredit Holding confirmed; Halkbank TR, Steiermärkische and the CCB/OTP lineages still unexplored). For A4 purposes the layer that matters most is the annual 'Годишен извештај за работењето', which is where card-transaction growth, POS/e-commerce growth, merchant-point counts and digital-banking user growth actually appear — but almost always as year-on-year percentages inside Cyrillic PDFs, not as absolute fleet counts. Комерцијална банка is the only bank found publishing dated investor presentations intra-year; everyone else is annual-cadence, so intra-year monitoring must lean on KB, NLB Group quarterlies and bank ATM locator diffs. The practical build is therefore: MSE/SEI-Net as the harvest spine, bank sites for narrative and network pages, parent groups for standardised comparables, and a separate regulator/scheme source for absolute levels.
